actual_observations: Event callback excludes cancelled/non-EVENT/client/already custom trader, tests configured chance, then writes old trader replaced=true BEFORE attempting new entity spawn. Null spawn returns without clearing old marker. No offer/inventory copy from old trader in callback; new entity gets48000despawn and persistence plus transient replacedTrader reference.

Next custom server tick deletes llamas leashed to old trader in radius8 and discards old entity, then clears transient reference. This replacement reference is not in local save/load, so this code has no durable old/new handoff receipt. Event spawn creates own llamas; no claim native order or crash behavior tested.

Interaction assigns this.offers to otherOffers or commonOffers by current viewer third-eye/goggles/staff, debug wand overrides. getOffers sees null active field and allocates new common offers, calls updateTrades and assigns commonOffers. Thus an uninitialized selected other/debug pool can fall into common creation before lazy child creation; actual first-view behavior native timing not tested.

Save first calls native parent with current active offers, then stores nonempty CommonOffers and OtherOffers only on server. Load parent first, then independently reads these child lists or null, then inherited inventory. Empty child list omitted on save can later regenerate randomly via getOffers. debugOffers and replacedTrader omitted from local persistence. Active selected list and child aliases/native parent contents require exact matching native read.
